paper.title_en: Small black hole in de Sitter as an observer
paper.abstract_en: We study the Euclidean path integral around magnetically charged lukewarm black holes in four-dimensional de Sitter space. We numerically determine the full one-loop spectrum of coupled graviton and photon fluctuations and find that the phase of the partition function agrees with that of pure gravity in empty de Sitter plus a worldline observer. In the small-mass limit, certain localized eigenmodes can be effectively viewed as describing the observer's motion and have the expected eigenvalues, allowing us to reconstruct the worldline action. We further identify these modes with translational zero modes of an extremal charged black hole in asymptotically flat spacetime, lifted by de Sitter curvature.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在四维de Sitter空间中考察磁荷lukewarm黑洞周围的欧氏路径积分，数值计算引力子与光子耦合涨落的完整单圈谱，并将局域本征模与观察者世界线作用量及渐近平直时空中极端带电黑洞的平移零模联系起来，理论深度和计算含量较高，与引力基础及黑洞热力学主题相关，值得点入阅读。
decision.title_zh: 作为观察者的de Sitter空间中的小黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了四维de Sitter空间中磁荷lukewarm黑洞周围的欧氏路径积分。我们数值确定了引力子与光子耦合涨落的完整单圈谱，并发现配分函数的相位与纯引力在空de Sitter空间加上一条世界线观察者情形下的相位一致。在小质量极限下，某些局域本征模可以有效地视为描述观察者的运动，并具有预期的本征值，从而使我们能够重构世界线作用量。我们进一步将这些模认定为渐近平直时空中极端带电黑洞的平移零模，这些模被de Sitter曲率提升。
